Third-party files, shipped with the app so it runs offline:

- `tf.min.js`: TensorFlow.js 4.22.0, Apache-2.0
- `coco-ssd.min.js`: @tensorflow-models/coco-ssd 2.2.3, Apache-2.0
- `ssdlite/`: COCO-SSD lite MobileNet v2 weights from storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models, Apache-2.0
- `jsQR.js`: jsQR 1.4.0, Apache-2.0
- `qrcode.js`: qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT
